description: Two silent-unless-relevant hooks. The dashboard-kit notice: one line at session start in a repository whose Fabric dashboard has no kit or an older one (fabric-dashboard/0.1, DEC-0036). The Fabric session hooks (working-with-fabric, COM-04): when Claude Code has the MCP server `fabric` and Fabric runs, the preamble at session start; each turn's facts (HEAD, files changed, lines added and removed, never content) and the session's end through Fabric, only when the running Fabric advertises session-hooks/1. Every hook reads no token, prints at most one block, always exits 0, and hands any Fabric call to a detached worker with a 10 s deadline.
